name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: A phone call I’ll never forget
body:
If you ever doubted we could win America’s youth back from the Left...

| | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2u3CAMhZ-G7DLin7LIotIoXd32qpsukQecBJVACmT6-lXunSfo1j4-tr_z6829QUwxr99hx2ktx-Fqc3BsJaOHlGJKGZ9Yl1JX7I5TrkfGRsYd-B6f6CQMYZKgpdZ6wIkZKxWzWvBhm-yiFosPpII9FOWG0oULjVYxIaQXfIjTZcgY45xJKujNoHkEzgxSpVVgjEiKIfZSb9dpFVsMmHuEdPNlH9K09X40Ir4SPhM-N_RnxRtkDKVfCsLnftYc8zoeJeY-ng0In41Vy0MZHC1aMUoMMFpEMcLyZVkUMtQIRMytnNWj8yUgEfdvP97ffzJlOJOE67PvbscQz52IO-4Q06v4OUTEfYMaoP124P-8Wh72A-Kaibj342zwiTC2_QPrS9SxXpZDncLxN6YUmzZE0vVa8fF0_8-UnhP_FwAA__9eNKGQ)
---
| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2u3CAMhZ-G7DLin7LIotIoXd32qpsukQecBJVACmT6-lXunSfo1j4-tr_z6829QUwxr99hx2ktx-Fqc3BsJaOHlGJKGZ9Yl1JX7I5TrkfGRsYd-B6f6CQMYZKgpdZ6wIkZKxWzWvBhm-yiFosPpII9FOWG0oULjVYxIaQXfIjTZcgY45xJKujNoHkEzgxSpVVgjEiKIfZSb9dpFVsMmHuEdPNlH9K09X40Ir4SPhM-N_RnxRtkDKVfCsLnftYc8zoeJeY-ng0In41Vy0MZHC1aMUoMMFpEMcLyZVkUMtQIRMytnNWj8yUgEfdvP97ffzJlOJOE67PvbscQz52IO-4Q06v4OUTEfYMaoP124P-8Wh72A-Kaibj342zwiTC2_QPrS9SxXpZDncLxN6YUmzZE0vVa8fF0_8-UnhP_FwAA__9eNKGQ)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2u3CAMhZ-G7DLin7LIotIoXd32qpsukQecBJVACmT6-lXunSfo1j4-tr_z6829QUwxr99hx2ktx-Fqc3BsJaOHlGJKGZ9Yl1JX7I5TrkfGRsYd-B6f6CQMYZKgpdZ6wIkZKxWzWvBhm-yiFosPpII9FOWG0oULjVYxIaQXfIjTZcgY45xJKujNoHkEzgxSpVVgjEiKIfZSb9dpFVsMmHuEdPNlH9K09X40Ir4SPhM-N_RnxRtkDKVfCsLnftYc8zoeJeY-ng0In41Vy0MZHC1aMUoMMFpEMcLyZVkUMtQIRMytnNWj8yUgEfdvP97ffzJlOJOE67PvbscQz52IO-4Q06v4OUTEfYMaoP124P-8Wh72A-Kaibj342zwiTC2_QPrS9SxXpZDncLxN6YUmzZE0vVa8fF0_8-UnhP_FwAA__9eNKGQ)
---
_But now, Friend, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**[If you're able to, I hope you'll help send a kit to the next student who raises their hand to lead by making your gift to Turning Point USA today.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2u3CAMhZ-G7DLin7LIotIoXd32qpsukQecBJVACmT6-lXunSfo1j4-tr_z6829QUwxr99hx2ktx-Fqc3BsJaOHlGJKGZ9Yl1JX7I5TrkfGRsYd-B6f6CQMYZKgpdZ6wIkZKxWzWvBhm-yiFosPpII9FOWG0oULjVYxIaQXfIjTZcgY45xJKujNoHkEzgxSpVVgjEiKIfZSb9dpFVsMmHuEdPNlH9K09X40Ir4SPhM-N_RnxRtkDKVfCsLnftYc8zoeJeY-ng0In41Vy0MZHC1aMUoMMFpEMcLyZVkUMtQIRMytnNWj8yUgEfdvP97ffzJlOJOE67PvbscQz52IO-4Q06v4OUTEfYMaoP124P-8Wh72A-Kaibj342zwiTC2_QPrS9SxXpZDncLxN6YUmzZE0vVa8fF0_8-UnhP_FwAA__9eNKGQ)**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Today**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2u3CAMhZ-G7DLin7LIotIoXd32qpsukQecBJVACmT6-lXunSfo1j4-tr_z6829QUwxr99hx2ktx-Fqc3BsJaOHlGJKGZ9Yl1JX7I5TrkfGRsYd-B6f6CQMYZKgpdZ6wIkZKxWzWvBhm-yiFosPpII9FOWG0oULjVYxIaQXfIjTZcgY45xJKujNoHkEzgxSpVVgjEiKIfZSb9dpFVsMmHuEdPNlH9K09X40Ir4SPhM-N_RnxRtkDKVfCsLnftYc8zoeJeY-ng0In41Vy0MZHC1aMUoMMFpEMcLyZVkUMtQIRMytnNWj8yUgEfdvP97ffzJlOJOE67PvbscQz52IO-4Q06v4OUTEfYMaoP124P-8Wh72A-Kaibj342zwiTC2_QPrS9SxXpZDncLxN6YUmzZE0vVa8fF0_8-UnhP_FwAA__9eNKGQ)
---
Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Andrew Sypher** Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA

On April 18, 1945, I walked up to my squadron commander and said, "This is my 75th mission. Don't you think it's time to quit?"He said, "Yeah. This is going to be your last mission."He was right. _Just not the way either of us meant._ My name is Wally King. I just turned 103. During World War II, I flew P-47 Thunderbolts over France and Germany with the 513th Fighter Squadron.

I grew up in rural Ohio. I went to all 12 grades in the same school building, and my graduating class had 32 students. All 16 of the boys served in the war.I'd wanted to fly since I was a kid building model airplanes. The P-47 was a tough, honest airplane. It could take a beating and bring you home.The mission I remember most came just before Christmas 1944, during the Battle of the Bulge.Our job was to knock out the German guns around Bastogne before the supply planes came in. Everything was buried in snow.When the parachutes dropped, men who had been dug in under all that white came up out of the ground and started dragging those supplies into town.**Patriot, I'll never forget that sight.** _Then came April 18._ On the way home, my wingman spotted a gun on a railroad car, and we went down for a look. Flak hit my engine. Fire came over the windshield.I bailed out over German territory with civilians shooting at me on the way down.Patriot, I was beaten, burned and terrified. I'd never given God much thought before that day, but right then, a peace came over me like nothing I'd ever felt. It stayed with me the whole two weeks I was a prisoner.**And it was a German doctor who got me home.** He was caring for badly wounded Americans in a house near the Russian front. When the war was all but over, he rode with us in two ambulances to the American lines, driving after midnight with no lights.I've often wondered how many of those boys would have lived without him.

For years now, I've talked to students about the war.**What troubles me, Patriot, is how little young Americans know about World War II.** When students ask me for advice, I tell them: _put down your cell phones and love one another._ But I can't get to every classroom, Patriot.**That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. They make sure the next generation hears the truth from the people who lived it.** AVC is a nonprofit educational organization dedicated to preserving and promoting the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes:
---
* **The National Memorial Day Parade** in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event
* **The Annual Veterans Conference** every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen
* **AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes,** a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide
* **Oral histories and documentaries** that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never lost

---
---
Election results show extraordinary movement towards Democrats across nearly every major demographic group, and turnout is up across the board. The message here is unmistakable: Trust must be earned, promises must be kept and Democrats will deliver.**ACROSS THE COUNTRY:**
---
* _Latino voters:_ Shifted 21 points toward Democratic House candidates compared with 2024.
* _Asian American voters:_ A 21-point shift toward Democrats. Democrats expanded their advantage among Asian American voters from 22 points in 2024 to 43 points in 2026.
* _Young voters:_ A stunning 48-point Democratic advantage. Democrats won voters ages 18–29 by 48 points, a 34-point shift from 2024. That’s an even larger margin than Barack Obama’s historic 34-point advantage among young voters in 2008.

---
**IN CALIFORNIA:**
---
* _Latino voters:_ Turnout rose almost 17 points from the 2022 midterms and shifted 30 points toward Democrats from 2024.
* _Asian American voters:_ Turnout rose 3.5 points from the 2022 midterms and shifted 10 points toward Democrats from 2024.
* _Black voters:_ Turnout rose 12 points since the 2022 midterms and shifted 12 points toward Democrats from 2024.
* _Young voters:_ Turnout is up nearly 14 points since the 2022 midterms, with a 31-point shift toward Democrats from 2024.

---
---
Together, we mobilized communities, turned out voters across the state, protected the vote, and once again showed the nation what’s possible when California Democrats come together with determination and an unfailing belief that a better future is possible. **Together, we WON!** We hope you are taking a moment to reflect, rest and celebrate our collective wins. Thank you for being part of this incredible effort and for proving once again that grassroots organizing really does make the difference. This victory belongs to all of us!\- Helen Amelga
CADEM Organizing & Training Director

subject: Florida’s message was clear

body:
| | | Friend, Election night was a decisive win for conservative leadership in Florida. Floridians had a choice between results and rhetoric, and they chose results. Here’s what the voters said:✅ Keep Florida free.✅ Keep our communities safe.✅ Keep common sense in charge. It’s not complicated, but in too many places across this country, those basics have been abandoned by weak leaders who talk tough and deliver nothing. Florida went a different way. We led with conviction, and we didn’t flinch when the legacy media and the Left came after us. People noticed. clean_body: Fellow Patriot, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftiMAGANEWS who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're MarxiMAGANEWS. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. LeftiMAGANEWS focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftiMAGANEWS destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. On April 18, 1945, I walked up to my squadron commander and said, "This is my 75th mission. Don't you think it's time to quit?"He said, "Yeah. This is going to be your last mission."He was right. _Just not the way either of us meant._ My name is Wally King. I just turned 103. During World War II, I flew P-47 Thunderbolts over France and Germany with the 513th Fighter Squadron.

I grew up in rural Ohio. I went to all 12 grades in the same school building, and my graduating class had 32 students. All 16 of the boys served in the war.I'd wanted to fly since I was a kid building model airplanes. The P-47 was a tough, honest airplane. It could take a beating and bring you home.The mission I remember most came just before Christmas 1944, during the Battle of the Bulge.Our job was to knock out the German guns around Bastogne before the supply planes came in. Everything was buried in snow.When the parachutes dropped, men who had been dug in under all that white came up out of the ground and started dragging those supplies into town.**Patriot, I'll never forget that sight.** _Then came April 18._ On the way home, my wingman spotted a gun on a railroad car, and we went down for a look. Flak hit my engine. Fire came over the windshield.I bailed out over German territory with civilians shooting at me on the way down.Patriot, I was beaten, burned and terrified. I'd never given God much thought before that day, but right then, a peace came over me like nothing I'd ever felt. It stayed with me the whole two weeks I was a prisoner.**And it was a German doctor who got me home.** He was caring for badly wounded Americans in a house near the Russian front. When the war was all but over, he rode with us in two ambulances to the American lines, driving after midnight with no lights.I've often wondered how many of those boys would have lived without him.

For years now, I've talked to students about the war.**What troubles me, Patriot, is how little young Americans know about World War II.** When students ask me for advice, I tell them: _put down your cell phones and love one another._ But I can't get to every classroom, Patriot.**That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. They make sure the next generation hears the truth from the people who lived it.** AVC is a nonprofit educational organization dedicated to preserving and promoting the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes:
---
* **The National Memorial Day Parade** in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event
* **The Annual Veterans Conference** every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen
* **AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes,** a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide
* **Oral histories and documentaries** that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never lost

| | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.”After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in.The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet.When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect.Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed.So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late.Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died.But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe.And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang...He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play...He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger...But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. **You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does.** And five months after that fateful day......she charged Erik with Manslaughter.She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus.They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents.What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial.But not only did the judge find Erik guilty......he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison.The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers!This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people.It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age.But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. clean_body: You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer. | | | | Dear Peter,I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate. | | | This is Erik, me, and our three children in the family photo.I wish I didn’t have to blur our faces. But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances.I should explain...You’ve heard about Erik on the news.He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk. | | | | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.”After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in.The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet.When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect.Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed.So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late.Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died.But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe.And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang...He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play...He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger...But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does. And five months after that fateful day......she charged Erik with Manslaughter.She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus.They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents.What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial.But not only did the judge find Erik guilty......he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison.The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers!This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people.It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age.But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area.Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood.And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community.But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children.Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done.Our five-year-old couldn’t understand.Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail?After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions.He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls.This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood. It’s disgusting.It’s unjust.And it’s just plain wrong.Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond.But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive.I had almost given up hope.But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once.On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. Thanks to kind-hearted people like you, they get these officers the lawyers and expert witnesses they need to fight back against activist prosecutors and judges......and win.Peter, you’ve already read my email this far, so I’m going to come right out and ask: I know it’s strange to ask for your support in the very first email I’ve ever written you.But we have nowhere else to turn.Erik and I come from working-class families.We’re not wealthy.And with Erik being found guilty, we lost his salary and our medical benefits. We’re barely getting by as it is. because LELDF is a nonprofit, your gift is tax-deductible too.But whatever God is prompting you to give, please act quickly.Erik’s legal team needs to be working around the clock on this appeal.Because if we don’t fight this injustice, Erik will be imprisoned. And you know how police officers are treated in prison. And when you access the secure donation page, you’ll see there is a box where you can type a message— If you’re a believer like Erik, maybe you could write a short prayer. I know it will mean the world to him. Peter, for the past three years Erik told me something over and over again: “It’s not about the hardships. It’s about the people God sends into your life during difficult times to help you.” I pray that today you’ll be one of those people God uses to help our family.Thank you, and God bless you.Sincerely, Cynthia Duran P.S. My husband doesn’t deserve this. He’s a decorated police officer who spent his entire career serving and protecting his city. That day in the park, he saved lives. And for that, Letitia James wants him locked up for NINE YEARS.Please don’t let the cop-haters destroy another good man. | | | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. * * *
The latest headlines about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang sound like a movie. An extramarital affair with a business executive, and a reported intelligence memo identifying the woman involved as an asset recruited by China's Ministry of State Security.
Huang sent out the following message to his company after this news went public:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b5b31834-3b95-49ee-bb29-b0bed694f200?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Nvidia insists it has no reason to believe sensitive national security information was compromised, and Beijing is aggressively denying the espionage allegations. Whether or not Huang knowingly assisted Chinese intelligence is still an open question.
Everyone wants to focus on the scandalous affair, but the real story is the glaring vulnerability in how America's elite class understands our relationship with China.
Nvidia builds the advanced semiconductors that sit at the absolute center of the U.S-China race for artificial intelligence supremacy. Jensen Huang also happens to be one of the loudest voices in Washington advocating for looser export controls so Nvidia can keep selling those chips to Beijing. For the Chinese Communist Party, cultivating a direct relationship with a guy like that is a no brainer.
We keep seeing this pattern because the common denominator is access. The CCP understands that access is power, whether they're buying it, hacking it, or sleeping with it.

[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..vby2381cuSb_RhTsiYAZRqfbJSVxttxObqjWkXnnwEI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=224649300)
Look at the track record. Just last month, two Chinese agents were sent to federal prison for bribing U.S. military personnel to map out installations and scout new recruits. Before that, federal prosecutors indicted Linda Sun, a former senior aide to two New York governors, for allegedly acting as an undisclosed agent of Beijing to steer state politics.
Military bases. State capitols. Corporate servers. And now, the inner circle of the guy holding the keys to America's AI advantage. These aren't random targets.
Here in the U.S., we have a terrible habit of confusing diplomatic politeness and lucrative commercial partnerships with a genuine alignment of interests. I've spoken on this Substack before about foreign influence campaigns manipulating American politics. But Beijing's game exposes another dimension: a foreign government methodically targeting the foundation of our economic, military, and technological dominance.
American executives look at China and see massive consumer markets and supply chain efficiencies. Chinese intelligence services look at American executives and see marks.
We have to stop pretending the Chinese government isn't actively working to dismantle our global standing. The Nvidia scandal is just the latest reminder. Commercial cooperation doesn't cancel out geopolitical competition. It just gives our rivals a closer angle to play us.

Hey folks,
This one is absolutely insane. Alina Habba just got fired from a multimillion-dollar job tied to a billionaire whose family secured a presidential pardon from Donald Trump. And somehow, Trump is furious about the money she made.
We're talking about a massive payday, a presidential pardon, and a growing corruption scandal that tells you everything you need to know about what's happening in Washington right now. You don't want to miss this one.
Here's what we get into:
* [**00:01:30**] Alina Habba gets fired from her lucrative contract but walks away with $14.5 million. The details of this deal are outrageous.
* [**00:04:08**] We break down the pardon, the money, and why I believe this raises serious questions about corruption inside Trump's inner circle.
* [**00:06:24**] Trump's $950 million presidential library is facing congressional scrutiny. Where is all this money coming from, and what are donors getting in return?
* [**00:09:27**] Habba's response to questions about donating her earnings to Trump's library says a lot about the arrogance and lack of accountability we're dealing with.
* [**00:11:29**] Corruption is a top concern for voters, and Democrats have an opportunity to demand answers, expose wrongdoing, and push for sweeping ethics reform.

This isn't just about Alina Habba. It's about a political culture where access to power can come with enormous financial rewards and where accountability feels almost nonexistent. | Dear Friend,
---
Unfortunately, I have some devastating news.
---
The vindictive Democrat Attorney General who is targeting me just won her reelection in a _landslide_.
---
When my lawyers had informed me that any day now, this AG could call a NEW grand jury to RESTART her sham case against me, I immediately knew what was on the line for me in the midterms.
---
Sadly, the shocking election results only make my situation that much more dire.
---
**_This Democrat AG is now more emboldened than ever to come after me with her false charges and phony _state-level_ case in which she knows President Trump cannot save me with a federal pardon! _**
---
While every word in this letter is the honest-to-God truth of where things stand for me – and it may currently look bleak – please rest assured that I will _NEVER_ _SURRENDER_ to the lunatic Left’s final witch hunt against me.
---
I’ve been to hell and back defending myself against the Democrats and their Deep State goons...
---
_They raided my home at dawn.
Arrested me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Froze my bank accounts.
Seized my assets.
And forced me to the point of bankruptcy.
_
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
__
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
**And yet, here I am... _still fighting_!**
---
That’s because in the end, I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”
---
The Democrats can strip me of all I’m worth – _all I’ll ever be worth_ – but what I refuse to surrender to them is my LEGACY!
---
**_"_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_**
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can NEVER AGAIN happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I’ve got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU_._
---
Friend, I understand this was probably the last thing on your mind today. I get it. And that’s why I always say that if you can’t afford to help me in this fight, please delete this message and carry on with your day. Don’t even think twice about it.
---
**_But if you can help, I’m going to need the best defense I can get to defeat this radical Democrat Attorney General who is hell-bent on locking me up for the rest of my life._**

body:
These races came down to razor-thin margins. Here’s how we won.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261112-1&t=1&akid=4243%2E587540%2E9sSivb)
Peter,
We saw Democrats win big all across the country. In winning the House and Senate, in flipping state legislatures, in breaking Republican supermajorities, in creating Democratic trifectas. But so many of these deciding races came down to razor-thin vote margins.
**Many of the races Leaders We Deserve invested in,_and won_ , came down to just hundreds of votes — or less.**
In Pennsylvania, **Brad Chambers** ran to flip a seat in the state House. His race was finally called last Friday and he won by just **_30 votes_**. Also in the Pennsylvania state House, **Tim Hayes** flipped another seat by a margin of about **_200 votes_**. In Texas, where Democrats flipped the state House, **Tyler Smith** beat his GOP opponent by just over **_2,500 votes_**. And in Ohio, **Kristina Knickerbocker** helped take back the House by defeating the longest serving Republican in Congress by just **_1.6%_**.
Without our support, many candidates wouldn’t have been able to compete in the face of huge GOP spending and entrenched opponents. Our candidates didn’t only compete, but they won. And when we invest more in our candidates, they win by larger margins.
This is where your grassroots support directly impacts the results of elections. Your support helps us invest continuously in our candidates, from the very beginning, and that’s what makes their races competitive. Every dollar spent, every mailer sent, every door knocked, and every vote cast mattered in these races and delivered a blue wave on Election Night.
**That’s why Leaders We Deserve does what it does. Our candidates have the passion, the ideas, and the drive to make a difference — and with the right support behind them, they can take out even the most entrenched incumbents.**
From the very beginning, we’ve had a winning record:
* In 2025, **Akbar Ali** was elected as the youngest member of Georgia’s General Assembly. And in his runoff election, he won by just **153 votes**.
* In 2024, **Molly Cook** won her state senate race by **74 votes** , making her the youngest state senator in Texas.
* In 2023, **Nadarius Clark** was our first ever endorsed candidate, and he won an incredibly competitive race in Virginia by less than **2,000 votes**.

Our record shows that community investment wins. We can compete with incumbent representatives, corporate spending, and breaking from the status quo. _But it takes all of us_.
That’s why we’re laying the foundation for 2028 now. We’re starting the search for young, bold leaders. We’re making plans to hold onto the seats our candidates won, and we’re paving the path to make the next cycle our biggest one yet.
**[These early investments pay off. If you’re with us in this fight, and ready to see even more change in 2028, chip in $5 so we can hit the ground running.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261112_1_close.6YKVLp&refcode=em20261112-4243&amount=5&t=2&akid=4243%2E587540%2E9sSivb)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

We can compete with incumbent representatives, corporate spending, and breaking from the status quo. But it takes all of us. That’s why we’re laying the foundation for 2028 now. We’re starting the search for young, bold leaders. We’re making plans to hold onto the seats our candidates won, and we’re paving the path to make the next cycle our biggest one yet. Thank you, David Hogg

| | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **Because people like you chose to act, this rescue was possible.**

**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to _stop_ _ __the sale __of God 's children._ Inspired by the film _Sound of Freedom_ , the Foundation works around the world to **prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children.** Our mission is simple. **To stop the sale of God 's children.** And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our **Freedom Strike Force** partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. **Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.**

clean_body: A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. Because people like you chose to act, this rescue was possible. Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. Your donation today can help: Train officers to find trafficked children Support rescue operations Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors Help children begin the journey to healing When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. What if it were my child? I could not stay silent. And you do not have to either. Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today? Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. Together we can make sure more children hear the sound of Freedom. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. The cost to staff, equip, and execute a Freedom Strike Force Training Camp is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission. Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

name: Chris Brooks, LCV
subject: Following up — Trump's rushing to sell off Yosemite, Ambler road and more — we have to stop him:
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQwOTMyODUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU4MDA2NTkyNgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter, since we messaged you earlier this week, hundreds of people from
all over the country have stepped up to defend the environment during these
critical weeks before the new Congress takes over. We know that Donald Trump has never accepted defeat quietly. There’s already a rushed attempt underway to gut protections for many national
monuments. They’re still trying to approve corrupt handouts like Ambler Road in
Alaska, and even selling off part of Yosemite. And there's still an effort underway to approve unlimited carbon emissions from power plants. Stalling these efforts — even for a couple of weeks — means the new Congress
will be in a position to hold Trump and his polluter cronies accountable and
deliver policies that protect people and the planet. We need everyone who cares about the future of our clean air, clean water, public lands, and communities to come together to defend our environment as the Trump era unravels. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~ With Trump’s grip on Congress slipping away, we have every reason to be
concerned about what he’ll try to push through before January. Just look at
what’s at stake: → Our public lands:Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante are just two of the monuments the Trump
administration has targeted, and it has even moved to sell off parts of
Yosemite. In these final weeks, his administration is ALSO still pushing
through corporate giveaways like the Ambler Road project, which would build a
211-mile mining road through Alaska’s wilderness for international mining
conglomerates. → Our clean air and water:Trump and congressional Republicans have been working to weaken hard-won
environmental protections like the Roadless Rule and even the Clean Air Act
since Trump’s second term began. Right now, we’re hearing they’re rushing to get
their schemes over the finish line before January. Trump’s EPA has already taken
steps to loosen limits on carbon pollution from power plants, and they have just
weeks to finish the job before they’re blocked by an incoming pro-environment
majority. → Our federal agencies built to protect the health of communities and the
planet:The Trump administration has spent its first two years in office sowing chaos
and confusion at federal agencies like the National Park Service, Environmental
Protection Agency, U.S. Forest Service, and the Bureau of Land Management with
illegal layoffs and other extreme changes to their staffing and budgets — and
these final weeks of the year are Trump’s last chance to do that without a
Congress willing to keep him in check. The damage Donald Trump and his allies can do before a new Congress can block
legislation, investigate their actions, and thwart his nominees for government
positions could take decades to undo, Peter. We can’t let our guard down before Congress is sworn in. We need to be ready and take action NOW. Please, renew your membership for $15 today to help LCV defend our environment >> https://links.messages.lcv. RENEW YOUR LCV MEMBERSHIP >> https://links.messages.lcv. We know what happens when Donald Trump gets angry. Families pay the price with
dirtier air, more polluted water, higher utility bills, sicker communities, and
the loss of our country’s most treasured places. And we know that protecting our planet takes more than one election, one vote,
or one victory. It takes a movement of people who refuse to back down in the face of pressure,
who refuse to be demoralized, who won’t stop standing up for what’s right. That’s what your LCV membership represents. Your membership helps power the
movement and the work that happens after all the ballots are counted: mobilizing
communities, demanding better for people and our environment, and protecting
this planet we call home. Help prevent the worst of what MAGA Republicans will try to inflict on our environment in the coming weeks and strengthen the movement we’ll need to push for progress in the year ahead. Renew your membership today, $15 is all it takes >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f0Nb~ Chris Brooks

body:
For the same video
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=168%2E42639%2Ex1xB7S)
See this guy?
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261112&t=2&akid=168%2E42639%2Ex1xB7S)
That's me in Iraq.
See this?
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261112&t=3&akid=168%2E42639%2Ex1xB7S)
That's the President of the United States — almost one year ago — calling for my death for making a video he didn't like.
A lot has happened since the president unleashed a flurry of bomb and other threats against me and my office.
He had a former Fox News host try to indict me (not Pete Hegseth, the other Fox News host... Jeanine Pirro).
He failed.
Then, nearly all of America - from coast to coast, red states to blue states, voted against him in historic fashion in the last midterm election.
**And yet here he is – just this morning – still Truth Socialing about prosecuting me and my colleagues for the same video.**
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261112&t=4&akid=168%2E42639%2Ex1xB7S)
Look... I have no idea what is going to happen next — with the president, with whether or not I am going to run for John Fetterman's Senate seat. I'll be doing a lot of thinking about that over the holiday.
But one thing I do know is that whether I am running for re-election or running for Senate, I will remain a political target of the president and the MAGA-right.
No pressing ask today. File it away.
But if you do want to make a contribution to let me know that you're with me, you can do that here:
**[Use this link to make a contribution to my campaign committee today. Our average online donation is around $30. Many give more. Some give less. All that matters is that lots and lots of people have my back in the face of these attacks.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261112&t=5&akid=168%2E42639%2Ex1xB7S)**

Derek, last Wednesday, we woke up to a country that is bending back toward justice. **The American people voted to give Democrats the majority in the Senate and the House.** Americans voted for lower costs. For a fair shot. To end the corruption and build a better future for all of us. Derek, the victory was _resounding_ , and we have you to thank. Behind this win are people who gave what they could, made one more call, knocked on one more door, or drove a neighbor to the polls. **Thank you.** I'm proud of what we did together, and I know how much it took. For two long years, Donald Trump brought this country corruption, chaos, cruelty, and higher costs, and Republicans in Congress — many of whom knew better — refused to stand up to him. Our founders built this great, improbable experiment in self-government, and they gave us a tool to check anyone who would rule like a king: the right to vote. On Tuesday, November 3, we said hell no to kings. We put Democrats in a position to bring down costs, investigate this president's corruption, and end this illegal war. I'm clear-eyed about the hard work still ahead, Derek. The president is not likely to be a willing participant in undoing his own agenda. He's going to test our resolve, to threaten and intimidate his favorite opponents — myself included. But together, I know we are capable of standing up to him and anyone who gets in the way of progress. After all, we did what many considered impossible on Election Day. _We can do it again._ Once more, thank you, Adam

And its first-ever Black senator elected by popular vote, since state lawmakers picked senators during Reconstruction. This historic win was powered by extremely high Black turnout — as well as years of organizing and community engagement by groups on the ground, laying the foundation for real change.
